question: The Chairman and members of the State Public Service Commission are appointed by the _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• The Governor is the constitutional head of a state in India.

• Under Article 316 of the Constitution of India, the Chairman and members of the State Public Service Commission are appointed by the Governor of the state.

• The State Public Service Commission is responsible for conducting examinations for appointments to the services of the state.

• The Governor's role in the appointment process ensures an impartial and fair selection of members to the State Public Service Commission.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Governor:**

• The Governor is appointed by the President of India and serves as the representative of the President in the state.

• The Governor's powers and functions include legislative, executive, and judicial functions as per the Constitution of India.

• The Governor appoints the Chief Minister of the state and other ministers on the advice of the Chief Minister.

• In addition to appointing the Chairman and members of the State Public Service Commission, the Governor also appoints judges of the state High Court and other key officials.

• **State Public Service Commission (SPSC):**

• The SPSC is a constitutional body established under Article 315 of the Constitution of India.

• The primary function of the SPSC is to conduct examinations for recruitment to various state services and advise the state government on recruitment rules, promotions, and disciplinary matters.

• The SPSC ensures a merit-based and transparent selection process for state government jobs.

• The SPSC's composition includes a Chairman and other members appointed by the Governor of the state.
